summary_en: MarketEnterprise announced a cost of capital target of approximately 8% (CAPM-based) and plans to stabilize ROE at 15–20% by improving profit stability and equity base. The company identified volatility from derivative valuation losses and business restructuring in reuse and mobile operations as impediments to consistent performance.
title_en: Response Toward Realizing Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
MarketEnterprise disclosed its response framework to realize management with heightened awareness of capital cost and stock price performance. The company set a shareholder cost of capital target of approximately 8% based on CAPM methodology. Current analysis shows ROE volatility stemming from derivative valuation gains and losses, along with business restructuring initiatives in the reuse and mobile segments. The company aims to stabilize ROE within a 15–20% range on a stable basis.

The core strategy combines two pillars: achieving profit stability and strengthening the equity base. The company identified that volatile earnings relative to business plans have created ROE instability, and commits to accurate execution of operational plans as the highest priority. Management indicated that stabilizing net profit margin while simultaneously enhancing shareholders' equity constitutes the path to sustainable capital efficiency. The presentation includes forward projections through June 2027 showing planned improvements in net profit margin and equity ratio, contingent on successful execution of restructuring in both the reuse and mobile business divisions.
